description: Contains Hedera Smart Contract Service supporting files
readme_summary: :warning: :bangbang: ***All examples and contracts in this repository are exploration code and have NOT been audited. Use them at your own risk!*** :bangbang: :warning: Reference library for Smart Contracts utilized by the Hedera network with supporting files and examples. The Hedera network utilizes system contracts at a reserved contract address on the EVM to surface HAPI service functionality through EVM processed transactions. These system contracts are precompiled smart contracts whose function selectors are mapped to defined network logic. In this way EVM users can utilize exposed HAPI features natively in their smart contracts. The system contract functions are defined in Hiero Contracts repository and implemented by the Hedera Services repo as part of consensus node functionality.
